column5: Last night, a voice on the radio read my address.
And now someone was at my door.
Then a piece of paper slid under the door.
Leave before sunrise. Don't stay on the list.
At sunrise, I opened the door.
But every door on our floor had a red X painted on it.
Like they vanished in the middle of dinner.
Back in our room, the radio clicked on by itself.
Residents on the list. Report to Wrigley Field by six P M. Bring nothing.
My grandson went there yesterday. He promised he'd come back.
Stay and freeze, or go and find out.
I started writing everything in this notebook.
The first engines in six days.
They stopped right outside our building.
He looked up... straight at our window.
